patient.name: 山内樱良
patient.diagnosis: 胰头部局限性病变，需要胰十二指肠切除与复杂消化道重建。
patient.diagnosis_en: A localized lesion in the pancreatic head requiring pancreaticoduodenectomy and complex gastrointestinal reconstruction.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「你好！这里就是那个……听说会接下很麻烦的手术的星见医院？」
lines.text_en: “Hello! Is this that... Hoshimi Hospital I heard takes on really difficult operations?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「确实接了不少麻烦的病例。先坐吧。」
lines.text_en: “We do take quite a few difficult cases. Please, sit down.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「医生，我的胰脏是不是特别不听话？」
lines.text_en: “Doctor, is my pancreas being especially disobedient?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「它的问题不在于听不听话。病灶的位置靠近重要血管，切除之后还需要重建消化道。」
lines.text_en: “Disobedience is not the issue. The lesion is close to important blood vessels, and after removing it we will need to reconstruct your digestive tract.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「听起来就像把一台机器拆开，再小心翼翼地装回去。」
lines.text_en: “That sounds like taking a machine apart and then carefully putting it back together.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「差不多。也正因为这样，手术过程中可能遇到我们事先看不见的困难。」
lines.text_en: “More or less. That is also why we may encounter difficulties during surgery that we cannot see beforehand.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「所以……要找很厉害的助手才行？」
lines.text_en: “So... you need some really good assistants?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「对。每个人擅长处理的问题不同，我得先把队伍安排好。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. Everyone is good at handling different problems. I need to put the team together first.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那我可以负责什么？」
lines.text_en: “What can I be responsible for?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「把这本笔记剩下的页数留给以后。」
lines.text_en: “Save the remaining pages in that notebook for later.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……医生，你这样说有点狡猾耶。」
lines.text_en: “...Doctor, saying it like that is a little unfair.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「好吧。那就拜托你们，帮我争取多写几页。」
lines.text_en: “All right. Then please help me win a few more pages to write.”

day3.title: 给屏幕外的人
day3.title_en: To the Person Beyond the Screen

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「医生！我听说手术已经做完了。」
lines.text_en: “Doctor! I heard the operation is finished.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「完成了。接下来还需要观察和恢复，不过最困难的一关过去了。」
lines.text_en: “It is. You still need observation and recovery, but the most difficult hurdle is behind you.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text_en: “...I see.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那我是不是终于可以认真考虑明年要去哪里玩了？」
lines.text_en: “Does that mean I can finally start seriously thinking about where to go next year?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「等身体恢复好了，再做计划。」
lines.text_en: “Make plans once you have recovered.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「真严格。……不过，谢谢你，坂口医生。」
lines.text_en: “So strict. ...But thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「不用谢我。」
lines.text_en: “Do not thank me.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text_en: “Huh?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「要感谢的话，去感谢屏幕另一边的那个人吧。为了让你走到今天，那家伙可费了不少心思。」
lines.text_en: “If you want to thank someone, thank the person on the other side of the screen. They went to quite a lot of trouble to get you here today.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「屏幕另一边……？」
lines.text_en: “The other side of the screen...?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……噗！虽然完全听不懂，不过听起来是个很好的家伙呢！」
lines.text_en: “...Pfft! I have no idea what that means, but they sound like a really nice person!”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「谢谢你！我还有好多好多事情没做呢！」
lines.text_en: “Thank you! There are still so, so many things I have not done!”
